company.name: Energent.ai
company.shortDescription: Autonomous AI analyst for data analysis, financial reconciliation, operations, and share-ready business reporting.
company.description: Energent.ai is an autonomous AI analyst that automates core business functions like data analysis, financial reconciliation, and operations. It handles messy real-world data at scale — spreadsheets, PDFs, scans, and docs — and delivers share-ready outputs like financial reports and presentations from a single prompt. It ranks #1 in accuracy on Hugging Face's DABstep data-agent leaderboard (94.4%, ~30% ahead of Google's agent) and is trusted by over 200,000 teams globally.
